title: Who are we trying to help, and how would they know we’d made their lives better?
summary: Chrissie Gregory and Sharon Davidson describe moving from service thinking to system thinking, bringing staff and family experience into leadership decisions, and what effective coproduction asks leaders to give up.

title: Making things change: a guide to systems change for young people
summary: A free, illustrated, 32-page working draft, with a student’s unreliable bus as its starting point. Diagrams, questions, and a worksheet help readers investigate recurring problems, power, evidence, and possible action. Comments and practical trials are welcome.

title: Where are the systems in ‘systems leadership’?
summary: Investigating and changing recurring patterns, including our own part in them. A combined essay on leadership development, public health, power, and the conditions that keep problems recurring.
